items.title: Safety

items:
Salt + Sunshine Beach House – Highland Parks, Blue Mountain Beach

Spacious Coastal Retreat for Families & Friends
This three-story beach house comfortably sleeps up to 13, featuring 4 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms—ideal for families or groups of friends. You can relax on the private back patio, unwind on multiple balconies with peek-a-boo Gulf views, or explore scenic neighborhood trails for golf cart rides and evening strolls.

Your Space & Access
You have full access to the entire home, including all three floors, the back patio, and multiple balconies. The garage provides easy access to the included six-seater golf cart with LED lights and air hockey table, perfect for family fun and neighborhood adventures. Free on-site parking for three cars is available, along with secure storage for bikes and beach gear.

Living & Dining
The open living areas feature modern coastal décor and high-end furnishings. You can relax on comfortable seating while streaming your favorite shows on Smart TVs. The fully equipped kitchen includes a fridge with ice maker, coffee maker, toaster, and a kitchen island with two high chairs, perfect for meals or casual gatherings. The dining area seats eight. A half bathroom and full-size washer and dryer, plus beach towels, are conveniently located on the main floor.

Sleeping Arrangements
* 1st Floor
Bunk Room: Two Twin-over-Twin Bunk Beds, Queen Sleeper Sofa, Smart TV. Guest Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo.
* 3rd Floor
Master Suite: King Bed, Sitting Area, Private Balcony, Dual Closets, Ensuite Bath with Soaking Tub and Stand-Alone Shower.
Guest King Bedroom: King Bed, Smart TV.
Guest Queen Suite: Queen Bed with Twin Pull-Out, Smart TV. Hallway Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo.

Highland Parks Community Amenities
Highland Parks is a premier, pedestrian-friendly resort community in the heart of Blue Mountain Beach, set on one of the highest elevations along the Gulf Coast. You’ll have access to the central Pool House oasis, featuring a lagoon-style community pool heated year-round (except January and February), a spa heated all year round, cascading waterfalls, a fire pit, and a poolside pavilion with a summer kitchen.

The community also features a four-story observation tower, offering panoramic views of the Gulf of Mexico and the surrounding Point Washington State Forest. Highland Parks’ location provides easy access to nearby beaches, miles of hiking and biking trails, and the local shops and eateries that make Blue Mountain Beach unique.

Beach Access
You’re just minutes from several public beach access points, with three located less than 1.5 miles from the house. Hop on the golf cart and you’ll be at the sand in no time!
* Blue Mountain Regional Access – 0.9 miles, a short golf cart or drive with limited parking
* Gulfview Heights – 1 mile, quick ride by golf cart, includes the Gulfview Heights Snack Shack
* Ed Walline – 1.5 miles, ample parking, near local shops and Shunk Gulley
* Grayton Beach State Park – 3.4 miles, $5 entry per car or cart
* Dune Allen Beach – 2.5 miles, larger access with parking, restrooms, and nearby Stinky’s Fish Camp

Nearby Dining & Attractions
Local favorites within walking or short golf cart distance include Blue Mountain Creamery (1.1 mi), Mimmos Italian (0.4 mi), Real & Raw (0.4 mi), Cowgirl Kitchen & Boxcar Annie (1 mi), Red Fish Taco (1 mi), Café Tango (1.2 mi), Pizza by The Sea, Pecan Jacks Ice Cream, Shunk Gulley, Vue on 30A, Sunrise Coffee, Local Catch, Perfect Pig, Pazzos Italiano, and Shelby's Beach Bar and Grill. You can also explore 30A’s bike paths, Gulf Place, Seaside, Rosemary Beach, Alys Beach, and Grayton Beach State Park, or plan fishing trips and other beach adventures.

Your stay at Salt + Sunshine Beach House comes with Xplorie’s best activities! Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!

Additional Information:
* Snowbird Friendly!
* Sorry, no pets are allowed.
* Golf carts are permitted.
* The pool is heated year-round (except Jan–Feb); the spa is heated all year.

A Benchmark initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.

reviews.text: We absolutely loved this property! The pictures do not do it justice, it is incredibly spacious. We had two families (4) kids and it did not feel cramped. The resort pool & hot tub were a big hit. An easy golf cart ride to several beach accesses! The house is very well stocked - extra fans in every bedroom. Plenty of beach toys & chairs.The house is right near the pool which makes it incredibly easy! You can see the ocean from the primary bedroom :)
